# Scheduler Runtime Checklist: SPEC-013A1 - GitHub Sync Automation and Poller Lifecycle

**Purpose**: Validate scheduler-runtime requirement quality for bounded automatic GitHub sync polling, lifecycle startup/shutdown, feature-flag default-off behavior, durable leases, stale recovery, and strict non-execution boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-05-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are scheduler-owned automatic polling requirements explicitly defined without relying on external cron as the product contract? [Completeness, Spec FR-004, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK002 Are independent Product Line/workspace lifecycle ownership requirements defined so the automation is not a process-wide singleton? [Completeness, Spec FR-002, Spec FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are bounded tick requirements documented for interval, page count, issue count, and elapsed duration? [Completeness, Spec FR-003, Spec FR-016, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK004 Are scheduler startup and shutdown requirements defined for registration, stopping future ticks, in-flight tick handling, and durable recovery after ungraceful process exit? [Completeness, Edge Case, Spec FR-035, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK005 Are feature-flag default-off requirements defined for both automatic scheduler behavior and manual-sync fallback? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, Spec FR-006, Spec SC-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the dedicated feature flag name and resolution path unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec FR-001, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK007 Are lifecycle state fields specific enough for operators to distinguish enabled, disabled, running, delayed, failed, partial, stale-recovered, and skipped states? [Clarity, Spec FR-011, Spec FR-012, Data Model §Poller Lifecycle Control]
- [x] CHK008 Are durable lease fields clear enough to identify run owner, run identifier, lease expiry, release, and stale recovery? [Clarity, Spec FR-019, Data Model §Poller Lifecycle Control]
- [x] CHK009 Are partial-run stopping reasons clear for page, issue, duration, rate-limit, and disablement bounds? [Clarity, Spec FR-017, Data Model §Partial Run State]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do scheduler/runtime requirements consistently preserve manual `POST /api/github/sync` as the fallback instead of turning it into a control endpoint? [Consistency, Spec FR-006, Spec FR-026, Contract §POST /api/github/sync]

- [x] CHK012 Are owner-selection requirements consistent across shared-repository polling, skipped non-owner outcomes, and unresolved ownership behavior? [Consistency, Spec FR-009, Spec FR-010, Spec FR-031, Spec FR-033]
- [x] CHK013 Are `FEATURE_AREA_LABEL_ROUTING` boundaries consistent with automatic polling ownership semantics? [Consistency, Spec FR-034, Data Model §Sync Ownership Decision]
